description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420501
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property boundaries. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
